properties.summary: Cloudflare Radar's hijack detection lists event 173548 at confidence 12 (Cloudflare's high band is 8 and above), first seen 2026-11-18T22:39:59Z, last seen 2026-11-18T22:44:55Z, by 49 of Radar's 280 route-collector peers. Prefixes: 46.22.112.0/20, 131.117.176.0/21, 185.183.56.0/22, 193.151.93.0/24, 193.234.17.0/24, 193.234.30.0/24 and more. Cloudflare's evidence: irr new origin invalid, rpki new origin invalid. Routing data alone doesn't tell a deliberate hijack (BO-H-4A) from an operator error (BO-H-4B) or a legitimate change the detector misreads (BO-H-4C). Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.
